author: Jane Smith
title: Apple Reports Record Q1 Earnings Beating Analyst Estimates
teaser: Apple reported record first-quarter earnings, beating Wall Street estimates by a wide margin.
body: Apple Inc. reported record first-quarter earnings on Thursday, beating analyst estimates by a wide margin. Revenue came in at $119.6 billion, up 2% year-over-year.
